entries.name: register-coll10-accept#0
entries.description: Output R4 = Coll^10[Byte] (each outer collection holding one element, the innermost empty). Coll[Coll[Byte]] is embeddable (code 0x1a, no recursion in TypeSerializer), so Coll^10 recurses 8 times through the generic-Coll path (0x0c): type depth 8 = MaxTypeDepth (TypeSerializer.scala:134-136). Round-trip identity.

entries.name: register-coll11-reject#1
entries.description: Output R4 = Coll^11[Byte]: type depth 9 > MaxTypeDepth = 8, and the JVM throws DeserializeCallDepthExceeded at type parse. An impl with a higher type depth limit, or none, round-trips it: the over-accept.
